cues.text: Hi! In this video we'll learn Gaussian elimination, a step-by-step method for solving systems of linear equations.
Here are three equations in three unknowns, x, y and z. Can you see the solution just by looking? Not really: every equation mixes all three variables.
Now look at this system. The last equation says seven z equals twenty-one, so z is three. Plug that in above, and y and x follow straight away.
Here's the surprise: both systems have exactly the same solution. Gaussian elimination is the recipe that turns the hard system into the easy one. Let's see how, and why it works.
